EQMF.description: Equilibrium Element Nodal Force (EQMF). The ELEM_TYPE drives how many entries NODE_FORCES must contain: TRUSS uses 2 axial forces, while BEAM / E-LINK / G-LINK use 12 (6 per node).

ELEM_TYPE.description: Element type. Case-insensitive. Determines the required length of NODE_FORCES: [ELEM_TYPE=TRUSS] expects 2 nodal forces (axial at each of the 2 nodes); [ELEM_TYPE=BEAM|E-LINK|G-LINK] expects 12 nodal forces (6 DOF components per node for 2 nodes). Enum wire values: TRUSS, BEAM, E-LINK, G-LINK.

ELEM_KEY.description: Element ID the equilibrium nodal forces are applied to.

NODE_FORCES.description: Nodal force values. [ELEM_TYPE=TRUSS] provide exactly 2 values (axial force at node 1 then node 2). [ELEM_TYPE=BEAM|E-LINK|G-LINK] provide exactly 12 values: the first 6 are the 6 DOF force components at node 1, the next 6 are the 6 DOF force components at node 2. A size below 2 (or below 12 for non-TRUSS types) is rejected by the handler.
